segments.name: People Inc.
segments.evidence: People Inc. - one of the largest digital and print publishers in America and is committed to content — made by people for people — that delights, teaches, inspires and entertains.

segments.name: Care.com
segments.description: Online destination connecting families with caregivers for children, aged parents, pets and homes, and caregivers with families.
segments.evidence: Care.com , a leading online destination for families to connect with caregivers for their children, aged parents, pets and homes and for caregivers to connect with families seeking care services.

segments.name: Search
segments.description: Provides general search services and legacy desktop search software to consumers and business partners.
segments.evidence: Search - consists of Ask Media Group , a collection of websites providing general search services and information, and Desktop, our legacy desktop search software business.

segments.name: Emerging & Other
segments.description: Collection of smaller businesses including a healthcare job platform, news website and film producer services.
segments.evidence: Emerging & Other - consists of: ◦ Vivian Health , a platform to efficiently connect healthcare professionals with job opportunities.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers, affiliate commerce partners, magazine subscribers, licensees, and families and businesses paying subscription and contract fees pay the company.
revenueModel.evidence: Digital revenue consists principally of advertising, performance marketing and licensing and other revenue. Print revenue consists principally of subscription, advertising, project and other, newsstand and performance marketing revenue.
